verifications.note: Teaches translating real-world application problems into linear equations and solving them via the addition/subtraction properties of equality — the core of 7.EE.4 (use variables to construct and solve equations that model problems).
Introduces function notation and the vertical line test, establishing that a function assigns each input exactly one output — the definition at the heart of 8.F.1.
Covers the ratio/rate vocabulary and phrase-to-expression translation that underpins ratio and rate reasoning (6.RP.3); foundational/supporting coverage rather than full problem-solving.

Rejected: this chunk evaluates a single power (x^2 at x=10), a grade-6 exponent-notation skill. 8.EE.1 requires the properties of integer exponents (product/quotient/power rules, negative exponents), which this does not teach. The 0.81 embedding score is a false positive.
